description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ResourceLoader' responsible for dynamically loading resources from specified locations. It includes methods for obtaining resource URLs, reading XML configuration, caching DOM trees, and instantiating specific resource loader classes based on XML configuration. The class facilitates resource management within the Apache OFBiz framework, supporting extensibility and dynamic resource loading based on configuration.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: Abstract class for dynamically loading various resources based on XML configurations, supporting caching and extensible resource loader implementations.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads a resource as InputStream using a specified resource loader.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a resource using a specified resource loader.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a ResourceLoader instance from cache or creates a new one based on configuration.

methods.name: readXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads and returns the root element of an XML configuration file.

methods.name: getXmlDocument
methods.description: Returns a cached XML Document object for a given configuration file.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML configuration file into a Document object.

methods.name: makeLoader
methods.description: Uses reflection to instantiate a ResourceLoader subclass based on XML configuration.

methods.name: fullLocation
methods.description: Constructs a full resource location string with environment and prefix.

methods.name: invalidateDocument
methods.description: Clears cached documents associated with a specific XML filename.
